# Public ProBerserk parser fixtures

Captured 2026-11-04, whitespace reduced, scripts and forms omitted. Tournament tables are
limited to their first six rows; deck quantities are retained in full.

- `tournaments.html`: https://proberserk.ru/tournament/list/all?format=standard&records=100
- `tournament.html`: https://proberserk.ru/tournament/c541b668-6348-485a-bfd6-870ab5580686
- `deck.html`: https://proberserk.ru/deck/4b026f8a-3994-4913-a7f6-a2ef5ec918ea
- `sideboard.html`: https://proberserk.ru/deck/0d2ffe7b-0ee3-414a-8bfd-45cac184fb2f

These historical fixtures test parsing, not current metagame claims. The independent
`scripts/proberserk_fixture.py` cache is synthetic and contains no real player results.
